QUOTE SOUGHT (Donald Trump, to reporters in the Oval Office, Wednesday 30 September 2026):
"We have to make that decision: We blow them up or make a deal. But the time is coming. It's going to end very soon, one way or another."
Asked how he plans to deal with Iranian officials he has repeatedly called "crazy": "Maybe you blow them up."
Also attributed to the same remarks: Trump called the campaign a "total military victory", said Iran had been "virtually destroyed" militarily and economically and that the US had "almost total control" / "virtually total control" of the Strait of Hormuz; "In fact, in the last three days, more oil has come out of the Hormuz Strait than at any time in the history of the Hormuz." Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth separately said US forces had "destroyed" Iran's navy, air force and nuclear ambitions.
